author: sascha
name: Extract the todo app for standalone and submodule use and split project-owned board data
description:
Scope: prepare the todo app (unfertig, per T0016) for its own repository, support standalone and embedded-as-submodule use, and migrate the current board into app-owned and procedural-game-owned data. This is a repository/data ownership change building on T0007's per-record storage and Git history, not a replacement for its concurrency safeguards.

Make the app run from a standalone checkout without depending on procedural-game or infinity. Provide documented defaults for data inside the app repository and an initialization path consistent with the requested one starter todo. Clarify what 'providing one todo' means before choosing starter content: a fresh-use example/onboarding task must not overwrite or limit the app's actual migrated development backlog. Keep fixture/example initialization separate from existing real board data and make repeat starts non-destructive.

Add explicit configuration for the active board location. In submodule mode ideas and task files must live outside the app repository, within the containing project. Document the default standalone location, a usable parent-relative example, what relative paths are resolved against, and precedence with existing --data/CLI settings. Launching from a different working directory must resolve the same configured board. Keep runtime locks, journals, receipts, backups and pending-history metadata scoped to that board so independent host projects do not share state. Detect invalid or ambiguous paths and missing repositories rather than silently writing into the app checkout.

Commit meaningful data edits in the Git repository that owns the configured board: the app repository for its standalone board, the parent project for embedded use. Resolve the actual owning Git worktree from the data path, not the server code path; preserve data-only commits and unrelated staged work. App implementation changes belong to the app repository. Update launchers, documentation, process guidance, and AI/human briefings to identify the resolved board, owning project, and process location correctly in both modes. Coordinate with T0013 and T0018 so prompts do not hard-code obsolete paths; use the chosen unfertig branding from T0016.

Inventory and classify every current idea and todo, including closed entries: todo-app development records go to the app's board; game/research records go to a suitable board directory in procedural-game outside the submodule. Move linked original ideas with their tasks while preserving exact text, attribution, IDs, dates, status, completion notes/summary fields, unknown fields, and implementation references. Plan handling of unprocessed ideas, cross-project tasks, and ideas referenced by tasks in both destinations; do not silently duplicate active work or leave dangling source_ideas links. Retain a migration manifest mapping old record locations to new ones and a recovery copy. Preserve historical references with explicit board context where IDs become ambiguous across boards.

Prepare a safe migration sequence with all affected writers stopped, validation before and after, interruption recovery, repeat-run checks, and a clearly designated authoritative destination for each record. Establish an explicit migration procedure for relocation under the current no-deletion policy; ordinary task-edit endpoints must not acquire unrestricted deletion behavior. Include existing pending commits/receipts and backups in the recovery plan. The extracted app repository/history must not accidentally include unrelated game board records via old data backups or copied parent Git history. Do not rewrite the parent history or discard unrelated work.

Acceptance: a fresh standalone checkout starts with the agreed starter behavior; an app checkout used as a submodule reads/writes parent-owned data with documented relative configuration; commits appear only in the correct owning repository and unrelated staged changes remain untouched. Temporary-repository tests cover both modes, arbitrary launch directories, concurrent edits, migration/restart recovery, and missing-path errors. A before/after record inventory proves every original idea/todo and source link is accounted for, and real app/game backlogs resolve to their intended boards. Deliver the prepared repository layout and exact steps for repository creation, submodule integration and publication.

Resolve before migration: app repository name/remote and extraction history strategy, exact parent data path/configuration format, starter-todo intent, and ownership of shared records. The source idea requests eventual publication, but this processing turn is planning only. A copied implementation briefing must establish explicit authorization and destination before any actual push, hosted repository creation, or publication; local preparation and data migration are distinct from those external steps.

2026-09-06: Codex assigned T0020. Preparing fresh app history, configurable board location, app board in todo/board, project board in boards/procedural-game, and lossless split with parent-owned recovery records. No hosted repository or push authorized.

2026-09-06 completed by Codex: extracted unfertig into a fresh local repository/submodule at todo/, with configurable board ownership and resolved API/briefing paths. Project board: boards/procedural-game (12 ideas/tasks); app development board: todo/development (8 ideas/tasks). All original records and links preserved, with migration manifest, hashes, exact original files and receipts kept only in parent board-migrations/t0020. The source was retired under an exclusive lock; new boards reject retired request IDs. Standalone initialization supplies one onboarding task in board/, separate from the development backlog; embedded mode resolves parent unfertig.json and commits data in the owning parent worktree. Tested: 41 temporary-repository tests, fresh standalone clone initialization/repeat start from arbitrary cwd, actual submodule config discovery, JS syntax, and browser inspection of app board and migrated briefing paths. App implementation commit d1a699e6a2721cbc3ba2c92943dd7a054628d029; parent integration 35cd0fcb0dc11c2e7477620c64fcf5a5ce1a333e; branch agent/t0020-extract-unfertig in both repositories. No hosted repository, push, or merge. UNFERTIG-MIGRATION.md contains publication and clone steps; the submodule URL currently points to a machine-local bare copy and must be replaced with the chosen hosted URL before sharing the parent. Future GitHub remote/visibility remains a user choice. Windows behavior is not exercised on this macOS host. Stop both board servers before switching to a branch with the old storage layout.
